records.command:
$productionProcesses=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process
$productionPids=@{}; foreach($productionProcess in $productionProcesses){$productionPids[[int]$productionProcess.ProcessId]=$true}
$productionProcesses | Where-Object { $_.Name -match '^python' -and $_.CommandLine -like '*production-frozen*semantic-worker.py*' } | ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{Pid=$_.ProcessId;ParentPid=$_.ParentProcessId;ParentAlive=$productionPids.ContainsKey([int]$_.ParentProcessId);WorkingSetBytes=$_.WorkingSetSize} } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
$preflightInspect = @'
const r=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('.dip-local/production-frozen/.dip-local/production-agent-preflight.json')); console.log(JSON.stringify(r.rows.map(x=>({arm:x.arm,stderr:x.stderr,errors:x.errors,tools:x.retrieval.map(y=>y.tool)}))));
'@
node -e $preflightInspect
